description:
## Motivation

`PathRouter::merge` hands each of the other router's endpoints back to `route` or `route_service`. For `Endpoint::Route`, the endpoint is already a `Route`, but `route_service` wraps it in `Route::new` again. Each merge of a router that holds a service route (`route_service`, `nest_service` and so on) therefore adds another layer of boxing and a `RouteFuture`. Every request to that route then pays for an extra clone of the service and an extra dynamic dispatch.

## Solution

Insert the existing `Route` with `route_endpoint` instead of calling `route_service`. Nothing else changes: the path is still validated and conflicts are still reported the same way.

The new test counts how many times a service is cloned while it handles a request, and checks that a merged service route is cloned as often as the same route used directly. Before this change it was cloned twice per request instead of once.

title: axum: Don't wrap merged service routes in another Route
